description: chinamax Host-aware session-lifecycle and Bridge-enforcement hooks. Jobs are session-scoped (ADR 0004, reversed 2026-07-30). SessionStart resolves Claude or Codex, writes the Host session registry, injects the running/recent Job digest, and exports the Host session id/token plus the selected plugin-data root. Claude retains synchronous predecessor/orphan repair and SessionEnd cleanup; Codex uses a detached token-safe SessionEnd reaper and intentionally does not adopt stranded orphan processes. Stop emits a non-blocking running-Jobs notice. UserPromptSubmit injects the live-Bridge roster and exact-name routing rule. PreToolUse provides canonical Bridge reinforcement and the Codex yolo backstop. Codex hook trust is configured by the Host, never forged by setup.
